summary: Iter 9: validated (1) proveedor auto-alta on POST /api/facturas-recibidas via API + UI (Manual dialog with new proveedor_nombre creates the proveedor visible in /proveedores), (2) DIR3/es_publica round-trip on /api/contactos POST+GET+PUT and full UI roundtrip via /clientes dialog (input-es-publica reveals input-dir3-oc/og/ut, saved & reopened persist), (3) Facturae 3.2.2 GET /api/facturas-emitidas/{id}/facturae returns application/xml + attachment header, contains <SchemaVersion>3.2.2</SchemaVersion>, both seller/buyer NIFs, three <AdministrativeCentre> with <CentreCode> and <RoleTypeCode> 01/02/03 for público clients (and NONE for non-público), InvoiceTotal 217.80 matches, XML well-formed; UI facturae-<id> button triggers file download (facturae_A2026-0009.xml) without JS errors.

issues: Persistent a11y console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent'. Same as iter7/8 — add <DialogDescription/> to silence.

action_items: (Optional) Add DialogDescription to remaining Radix Dialog components.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py ensure_proveedor: lookup by NIF first then case-insensitive nombre regex — solid dedup logic. Same pattern in ensure_cliente. Auto-alta triggered from crear_factura_recibida (line ~1053), _make_documento_routes.crear (line ~479), and convertir_documento compra→factura (line ~1219). Coverage looks complete.

server.py _facturae_xml: uses stored lineas' `base` and `cuota_iva` fields (populated by calcular_lineas). Ensure any legacy invoices with different line schemas (e.g., only `precio`+`iva`) still work — currently missing keys default to 0 causing InvoiceTotal 0. Consider fallback compute if base/cuota_iva missing.
server.py _facturae_xml uses InvoiceClass 'OO' (Original) / 'OR' (Original Rectificativa) — spec-compliant. Uses <UnitOfMeasure>01</UnitOfMeasure> (unidades) hardcoded — acceptable for MVP.
_facturae_centros only emits centros for present DIR3 codes; if ALL three are empty, section is omitted entirely — correct for non-público clients. Confirmed by test_facturae_nonpublic_no_centres.
Contactos.jsx conditional DIR3 section renders only when form.es_publica is true — clean UX. DIR3 inputs uppercase automatically (.toUpperCase()) — good.
FacturasEmitidas.jsx descargarFacturae likely uses window.open or an <a download> — worked in headless (triggered expect_download event). Filename honored from Content-Disposition.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for tested flows (DIR3 roundtrip, proveedor auto-alta, Facturae download)

test_credentials: License auto via REACT_APP_LICENSE_KEY=NEXO-DEMO-0001. Admin (not needed): admin@nexopro.com / Admin1234!

Facturas cannot be deleted by design.
context_for_next_testing_agent: For POST /api/facturas-emitidas and /api/facturas-recibidas the line schema uses `precio_unitario` and `tipo_iva` (NOT `precio` or `iva`) — passing wrong keys silently produces 0€ invoices. Facturae button data-testid pattern: facturae-<id>. DIR3 inputs hidden until input-es-publica checkbox is checked. In Contactos edit dialog the pencil edit button is typically the first svg button in the row's action cell; use search box to filter row first. In direct-invoice modal you must add a line via + Desde artículo... dropdown before Emitir factura enables the warning dialog; a bare Emitir call shows toast 'Añade al menos una línea'.
